classification_precedence: invalid JSON or missing non-empty plan_id => invalid
explicit duplicate identity disposition => its recorded role
unique specs/roadmaps JSON with non-empty plan_id => primary_import_candidate
all Markdown => historical_evidence unless generated export receipt exists
all other docs/plans JSON => supporting_reference unless separately declared control-plane authority
identity_rule: Canonical target owner/project is not inferred from filesystem path. A future import command must require explicit owner_id, project_id and roadmap_id and bind plan_id plus source SHA-256; missing or conflicting identity fails closed.
no_authority_rule: No legacy source may remain current_source_of_truth after an accepted migration receipt; before that receipt it is only an import candidate, not a mutable canonical head.
